payload.title: Reproduce LMR Paleoclimate Book Project
payload.summary: The Reproduce LMR Paleoclimate Book Project aims to replicate the LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction process through a series of Jupyter notebooks. The project is divided into three main phases: data assembly, data assimilation, and validation. Each phase involves specific tasks such as constructing proxy databases, running data assimilation processes, and validating the reconstructed climate data against known datasets. The project utilizes various libraries and tools, including Pyleoclim, cfr, and LiPD, to handle paleoclimate data and perform necessary analyses.

phases.role: Assemble and prepare paleoclimate data for assimilation.
Execute data assimilation to reconstruct climate fields.
Validate the reconstructed climate data against known datasets.

end_to_end_steps.title: Correlating two GeoSeries
end_to_end_steps.description: Compute the correlation between two GeoSeries using the pyleoclim library.

end_to_end_steps.title: Database Assembly using the LMRv2.1 pickle file
end_to_end_steps.description: Construct a ProxyDatabase object using PAGES 2k proxy records from LMRv2.1 pickle files.

end_to_end_steps.title: Database Assembly using cfr's built in PAGES 2k database
end_to_end_steps.description: Construct a proxy database using the PAGES 2k (v2.0.0) records with the 'cfr' library.

end_to_end_steps.title: Run Data Assimilation
end_to_end_steps.description: Execute a data assimilation process to reproduce the LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction.

end_to_end_steps.title: Plotting as a GeoSeries Dashboard
end_to_end_steps.description: Explore and visualize a subset of LiPD datasets using Pyleoclim.

end_to_end_steps.title: Loading LiPDverse Data and Plotting as GeoSeries
end_to_end_steps.description: Load paleoclimate datasets from the LiPDverse and create a Pyleoclim GeoSeries.

end_to_end_steps.title: Proxy Database Forensics
end_to_end_steps.description: Identify differences and similarities between two proxy databases using the `cfr.ProxyDatabase` class.

end_to_end_steps.title: Validating a Reconstruction
end_to_end_steps.description: Validate a paleoclimate reconstruction by comparing it to the original LMRv2.1 reconstruction and multiple instrumental datasets.
